title: Happy Boy Digging Sand on Beach, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid vintage black and white snapshot photo taken in June 1956 showing a joyful young boy crouching down on a coastal beach, digging in the wet sand with a toy shovel. In the background, rocky cliffs and other vacationers can be seen along the shoreline. The image features classic deckled scalloped borders and a photo lab date stamp of JUN 56 along the right margin.
